verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Branching with isolated preview environments for each pull request, so changes to configurations, schemas, and features can be tested and reviewed before merging. Its MCP tools add migration tracking (`list_migrations`/`apply_migration`) and experimental branch merge/reset/rebase. Automations themselves (Cron jobs, Database Webhooks, Edge Functions) are never documented as versioned or rollback-able objects, so this support is indirect rather than a first-class versioning/rollback feature. Missing for 10: explicit version history for cron jobs, webhooks, and Edge Functions; a documented rollback of an automation to a prior version; independent corroboration of the review workflow.
